label: letter o input at steps 3-6 after t/r, mostly in sequences starting with 0
explanation: Very sparse (about 0.006% of steps), conjunctive feature. 97% of activation mass is in the original phase at steps 3-5, and none is in the copy phase. 74% of the mass is on input o (22x lift). The previous input is usually t or r (prev_tok t has 20x lift, r 6x; prev2 t/r about 9x), and the first original token is usually 0 (22x lift, 78% of mass). The strongest examples look like 0 _ r t o or 0 _ _ t o at step 4. Activation is largest when all three cues are present; when o follows t/r without a leading 0, or comes later than step 6, the feature is weak or silent. It never fires on o in the copy phase. A small residual (3%) fires at <DEL> after ...t. Precision is low because many o-after-t/r steps in sequences starting with 0 stay inactive, and many weak activations lack one of the cues, so the best predicate reaches only F1 of about 0.3 and mass recall of about 0.45 on dev.
